z-m-19-02.title: Ikho inkcazelo yesibini enye kuphela enezisombululo ezimbini ezi-2 ne-−5?
z-m-19-02.topic: Ukwenza inkcazelo yesibini kwizisombululo ezimbini ezinikiweyo, nemeko yokuyigqiba ibe nye
z-m-19-02.goal: Bonisa ngemizekelo emininzi ukuba nangona izisombululo ezimbini zinikiwe, inkcazelo yesibini ayigqitywa ibe nye, uze uhlele ukuba luluphi ulwazi olongezelelweyo olugqiba inkcazelo ibe nye noluphi olungenguye lutsha.
z-m-19-02.material: USua wabuza umbuzo. "Ndixelele inkcazelo yesibini enezisombululo (iingcambu) ezimbini ixabiso x=2 no-x=−5." Inkcazelo yesibini ibhalwa ax²+bx+c=0 (a≠0), kwaye ngezantsi, a, b, c ngamanani apheleleyo. (Funda x² njenge-"x isikwere" kunye ne-−5 njenge-"ukususa 5".)
z-m-19-02.thinking.0: Ukugweba ukuba ulwazi olunikiweyo lwanele na
z-m-19-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza imizekelo emininzi enelisa iimeko nokufumana ubudlelwane phakathi kwazo
z-m-19-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlela ukuba imeko eyongezelelweyo lulwazi olutsha ngokwenene na
z-m-19-02.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yezisombululo zenkcazelo yesibini, nokuhlola ngokufaka izisombululo
z-m-19-02.s.s1.prompt: Ingaba inkcazelo yesibini igqitywa ibe nye ngolwazi 'izisombululo zi-2 no-−5' kuphela?
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala yenza inkcazelo enye yesibini enezisombululo ezi-2 ne-−5 (umz. yandisa (x−2)(x+5)=0), uze ufake izisombululo ukuhlola ukuba iba yi-0.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya ukuba ungenza inkcazelo enezisombululo ezifanayo kodwa imilinganiselo eyahlukileyo kwenayo oyenzileyo, ufake izisombululo ukuhlola.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.a: Igqityiwe. Ukuba izisombululo ziyafana, inkcazelo inokuba yafana kuphela
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.a: Awuzange uvavanye ukuba ziyakho na iinkcazelo ezininzi ezinezisombululo ezifanayo. Emva kokwenza inkcazelo enye enezisombululo ezi-2 ne-−5, zama ukutshintsha imilinganiselo.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.b: Ayigqitywanga. Kodwa iinkcazelo kuphela ezinezisombululo ezifanayo ezimbini ezo zitshintshe uphawu luka-a
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.b: Kuchanekile ukuba inkcazelo ayigqitywa ibe nye, kodwa asingophawu kuphela olutshintshayo. Yenza neenkcazelo apho ubukhulu buka-a butshintshwa baya kwi-2 okanye ku-3, ufake izisombululo.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.c: Ayigqitywanga. Kusenokubakho iinkcazelo ezininzi ezinezisombululo ezifanayo
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.d: Igqityiwe. Inkcazelo evela ekwandiseni (x−2)(x+5)=0, eyenziwe ngezisombululo ezimbini, yimpendulo
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.d: Unokwenza inkcazelo enye ngokwandisa (x−2)(x+5)=0, kodwa inkcazelo eyenziwe ngokuyiphindaphinda ngenani elingeyo-0 inezisombululo ezifanayo nayo. Faka izisombululo kwinkcazelo enemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba ufaka x=2 no-x=−5 kwi-x²+3x−10=0, zombini zinika i-0, kwaye i-2x²+6x−20=0, ephindaphinda amacala omabini ale nkcazelo ngo-2, igcina izisombululo zombini nayo. Ngoko izisombululo zodwa azigqibi inkcazelo ibe nye. Kwinyathelo elilandelayo, siza kwenza iinkcazelo ngokwethu ukubona ukuba zingaphi ezinokwenzeka.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza iinkcazelo ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo zesibini ax²+bx+c=0 ezinezisombululo ezi-x=2 no-x=−5 zombini. (a, b, c ngamanani apheleleyo kwaye −9≤a≤9)
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.0: Thatha ukwandiswa kwenkcazelo (x−2)(x+5)=0 eyenziwe ngezisombululo njengesiqalo, uvavanye ukuba ngawaphi utshintsho kuyo olushiya izisombululo njengoko zinjalo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala imilinganiselo (a, b, c) yeenkcazelo ozenzileyo kwitheyibhile uthelekise indlela b no-c ezitshintsha ngayo ecaleni kokutshintsha kuka-a.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Yinkcazelo yesibini kwaye imilinganiselo ihambelana neemeko.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a akufuneki ibe yi-0 kwaye kufuneka ibe linani eliphelele elisuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9, kwaye b no-c kufuneka zibe ngamanani apheleleyo nazo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Faka x=2. Ngaba icala lasekhohlo liba li-0?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Inkcazelo iyabamba xa ufaka x=−5 nayo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Faka x=−5. Ngaba icala lasekhohlo liba li-0?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.explain: Ukufaka x=2 no-x=−5 kunika 4a+2b+c=0 kunye ne-25a−5b+c=0, kwaye kwezi nkcazelo mbini ufumana b=3a, c=−10a. Ngoko nje ukuba ugqibe a, b no-c ziyalandela, kwaye iinkcazelo ezinokwenzeka zezo x²+3x−10=0 ephindaphindwe ngamacala omabini ngenani elifanayo elingeyo-0.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ubudlelwane obuthini phakathi kweenkcazelo ozenzileyo? Bhala indlela imilinganiselo etshintshe ngayo, ufaka amanani.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Beka a, b, c zeenkcazelo ezimbini ozenzileyo ecaleni kwelinye uzithelekise ngokwahlula (umlinganiselo).
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Faka x=2 kwinkcazelo eyenziwe ngokuphindaphinda amacala omabini e-x²+3x−10=0 ngenani elifanayo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uhlolile ukuba ubudlelwane obufanayo bubamba kuzo zonke iinkcazelo ozenzileyo?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchazile, nangomgca omnye, ukuba kutheni obo budlelwane bungatshintshi izisombululo?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukuba uphindaphinda amacala omabini e-x²+3x−10=0 ngo-2, iba yi-2x²+6x−20=0. Imilinganiselo yonke yakhula ngomlinganiselo ofanayo kwaye izisombululo ziyafana.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Kwiinkcazelo endizenzileyo, xa a yayi-1, 2, −1, b yayi-3a kwaye c yayi-−10a. Ndiphindaphinde yonke inkcazelo ngenani elifanayo, ngoko izisombululo ezimbini azitshintshi.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Xa ndatshintsha a yaba yi-1, 2, −1, b yalandela njenge-3a kwaye c njenge-−10a. Umlinganiselo wemilinganiselo uhlala ufanayo, 1:3:−10.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.prompt: USua ufuna ukongeza imeko yokugqiba inkcazelo ibe nye. Ukongeza kwimeko yokuba izisombululo zi-2 ne-−5, khetha zonke iimeko ezigqiba inkcazelo yesibini ax²+bx+c=0 (a, b, c ngamanani apheleleyo) ibe nye.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa ubudlelwane b=3a, c=−10a, guqula imeko nganye ibe yintetho esebenzisa a kuphela.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ukuba a enelisa imeko etshintshiweyo inye kuphela okanye ininzi.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.a: a=1, 2, 3 ... zonke ziyahlala, ngoko ayigqitywanga ibe nye. Ukugqiba uphawu kuphela akugqibi ubukhulu benani eliphindaphindwayo.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.b: Ukuba uphosisa ubudlelwane c=−10a, kunzima ukuqonda ukuba le meko igqiba a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba izisombululo ezimbini zi-2 ne-−5, isixa sele si-−3. Uthathe ukuphinda ulwazi osele lunikiwe njengolwazi olutsha.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba ufaka ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-a, b, c ubhale a+b+c ngonobumba omnye, ungabona ukuba le meko igqiba a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.e: Ukuba a ayiyi-0, ngoko b=3a no-c=−10a azili-0 nazo, ngoko oku sele kubamba. Asilolwazi lutsha.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.f: Ukuba a=1, ngoko b=3 no-c=−10 ziyagqitywa. Ibonisa ulwakhiwo apho nje ukuba umlinganiselo omnye ugqityiwe, osele uyalandela.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.explain: Ukuba izisombululo zi-2 kunye ne-−5, ngoko (a, b, c)=(a, 3a, −10a). Ukuba c=−10a=−10, ngoko a=1; ukuba a=1, ngoko (1, 3, −10); ukuba a+b+c=a+3a−10a=−6a=−6, ngoko a=1; zonke ziyalungisa kube yinye. Imeko yokuba a ilungile ishiya a njenge-1, 2, 3 ..., kwaye izitatimenti zokuba isixa sezisombululo ezimbini si-−3 nokuba onke amakoyifishenti ayi-nonzero sele zaziwa, ngoko azinakuyincitshisa i-equation.

z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b ngamanani emvelo ahambelana neemeko.
z-m-19-01.title: Ingaba √a+√b ilingana ne-√(a+b)?
z-m-19-01.topic: Isixa samanani amabini aneentsika zesikwere singabhalwa ngefom enjani?
z-m-19-01.goal: Bonisa ngomzekelo omnye ochasayo ukuba '√a+√b=√(a+b)' ayihlali ibamba, ufumane wena izibini (a, b) apho isixa seentsika zesikwere ezimbini siba lula sibe yifom enye ye-radical, uze ubhale ngamagama into abelana ngayo.
z-m-19-01.material: UMinjae wathi, "Ukubhala isixa seentsika zesikwere ezimbini, dibanisa nje amanani asezantsi kwemiqondiso ye-radical uwabhale njengelinye. Umzekelo, √2+√3 yi-√5." Ngezantsi, vumela a no-b zombini zibe zi-positive, kwaye ibango likaMinjae libe yi-'√a+√b=√(a+b)' (intsika a kunye nentsika b ilingana nentsika ye-a kunye no-b iyonke). Isalathiso: √2≈1.414, √3≈1.732, √5≈2.236.
z-m-19-01.thinking.0: Ukuvavanya ibango ngamanani athile nokuqonda amandla omzekelo omnye ochasayo
z-m-19-01.thinking.1: Ukwenza imizekelo emininzi enelisa iimeko nokufumana ulwakhiwo olufanayo
z-m-19-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza ngokubanzi ngamagama into oyibonileyo ebelwana ngayo
z-m-19-01.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yeentsika zesikwere kunye ne-√a×√b=√(ab) (inqanaba leBanga 9)
z-m-19-01.prereq.1: Ukufumana amaxabiso aqikelelweyo eentsika zesikwere ngekhalkyuleyitha
z-m-19-01.s.s1.prompt: Ukuvavanya ibango likaMinjae, sifaka a=9, b=16. √9=3 kwaye √16=4, ngoko √9+√16=7, kwaye √(9+16)=√25=5. Yeyiphi indlela efanelekileyo kakhulu yokutolika esi siphumo?
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bala √9+√16 kunye ne-√(9+16) ngokwahlukileyo, ubhale ecaleni kwelinye uthelekise.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba kufuneka zibe zingaphi imizekelo engabambiyo ukuze 'ibamba kuzo zonke a, b' ibe ngobuxoki.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.a: Yimeko enye kuphela eyiphosakeleyo, kwaye kunokwenzeka ukuba ibambe kwezinye a, b
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.a: Ibango elithi 'kuzo zonke a, b ezi-positive' liphulwa ngumzekelo omnye kuphela ongabambiyo. Ukuphatha omnye njengomkhethiweyo kufana nokutshintsha ibango libe 'lichanekile ngokuyingxenye'.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.b: Kufuneka ufumane eminye imizekelo embalwa uqhubeke uphosisa ngaphambi kokuba uthi ibango liphosakele
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.b: Ukubonisa ibango lichanekile, akukho nani lemizekelo elinelayo, kodwa ukubonisa liphosakele, umzekelo omnye ochasayo wanele. Uphatha iimeko ezimbini ngendlela efanayo.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.c: 7 no-5 ziyahluka, ngoko eli bango alibambi kuzo zonke a, b ezi-positive
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.d: 9 no-16 ziikwere ezigqibeleleyo, ngoko zikhethekile, ngoko olu vavanyo alunakusetyenziswa njengobungqina
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.d: Ibango lithi 'a, b ezi-positive,' ngoko izikwere ezigqibeleleyo ziqukiwe. Ukulahla uvavanyo ngenxa yokuba amaxabiso abonakala ekhethekile kukuvumela ukuphepha umzekelo ochasayo.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.explain: Ukuba ibango li-'ihlala,' umzekelo omnye ongabambiyo (√9+√16=7, √25=5) wanele ukuliphula. Noko ke, oku kuthetha kuphela ukuba 'eli bango alihlali lichanekile,' hayi ukuba akukho sixa sinokubhalwa njenge-radical enye. Kwinyathelo elilandelayo sikhangela iimeko ezinjalo.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.prompt: Indlela kaMinjae iphosakele, kodwa zikho iimeko apho √a+√b iba lula ibe yifom enye p√m (p, m ngamanani endalo). Fumana izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo (a, b) ezinjalo. Iimeko: a no-b ngamanani endalo ane-2≤a<b≤200, kwaye akukho namnye wazo olikwere eligqibeleleyo (1, 4, 9, 16 ...).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala khetha nasiphi na isibini, njenge-a=5, b=7, fumana isixa ngekhalkyuleyitha, uhlole ukuba eli xabiso lihlulwe ngu-√5 linani lendalo na.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala izibini ezimbalwa ezisebenzayo ecaleni kwelinye ujonge ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-a no-b (ixabiso lokudibanisa, ukuphindaphinda, okanye ukwahlula).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Akukho namnye ka-a okanye b olikwere eligqibeleleyo.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c2: a okanye b likwere eligqibeleleyo. Tshintshela kwinani elingelilo ikwere eligqibeleleyo.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c3: √a+√b iba lula ibe yifom enye p√m.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Kwesi sibini, isixa asiba lula sibe yifom enye ye-radical. Bhala √a no-√b nganye ngefom yazo elula kakhulu ecaleni kwelinye uthelekise.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, √2+√8=√2+2√2=3√2, √3+√12=√3+2√3=3√3, √12+√27=2√3+3√3=5√3. Kuphela ukuba inani elifanayo lisala ngaphantsi kwe-radical xa lenziwe lula ngangoko linokwenziwa, anokudityaniswa abe nye. Kwizibini ezinjalo, a×b likwere eligqibeleleyo (2×8=16, 3×12=36, 12×27=324). Ngokuchasene, ukuba amanani asalayo ayahluka, njenge-√5+√7, awunakudityaniswa abe yi-radical enye.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Yintoni oyibonayo ngokufanayo kwizibini ozifumeneyo? Kwaye bhala, ufaka amanani, ukuba kutheni inkcazelo kaMinjae √a+√b=√(a+b) ingabambi kwesinye sezibini ozifumeneyo.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kwesinye sezibini ozifumeneyo, bhala a no-b nganye njenge-(inani lendalo)×√(inani elincinci).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Fumana amaxabiso aqikelelweyo e-√a+√b kunye ne-√(a+b) ngekhalkyuleyitha uwathelekise.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uhlolile ukuba into ebelwana ngayo oyikhankanyileyo ibamba ngokwenene kuzo zonke izibini ozifumeneyo?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubonise ukuba inkcazelo kaMinjae iphosakele ngokuthelekisa amaxabiso amabini (isixa ne-√(a+b))?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Kwi-(2, 8), √8=2√2, ngoko √2+2√2=3√2. Sisibini apho amanani asezantsi kwe-radical afanayo xa enziwe lula. Kodwa √(2+8)=√10≈3.16 kwaye 3√2≈4.24, ngoko amaxabiso ayahluka, kwaye inkcazelo kaMinjae ayibambi.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukujonga i-(3, 12) ne-(12, 27), imveliso ka-a no-b likwere eligqibeleleyo, njenge-3×12=36 ne-12×27=324. Umzekelo, √3+√12=3√3≈5.20, kodwa √15≈3.87, ngoko azilingani.

z-m-19-03.title: Kwenzeka ntoni kwinani eliphantsi kakhulu xa uluhlu lwe-x lutshintsha?
z-m-19-03.topic: Inani elikhulu kakhulu nelincinci kakhulu lomsebenzi wekhwadratiki onoluhlu olunqunyiweyo lwe-x
z-m-19-03.goal: Xa uluhlu olutsha lwe-x lunikiwe, gcina okanye uphinde ujonge isigwebo sakho ngenani eliphantsi kakhulu lomsebenzi wekhwadratiki, uze wenze uluhlu wena apho incopho ingaphandle koluhlu ufumane inani layo eliphantsi kakhulu.
z-m-19-03.material: U-Doha waphinda wabhala umsebenzi wekhwadratiki y=x²−4x+1 njenge-y=(x−2)²−3 wathi, "Inani eliphantsi kakhulu li-−3." Kodwa ngokuxhomekeke kwingxaki, uluhlu lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa yi-x nalo luyatshintsha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, uluhlu (njenge-x ingu-3 okanye ngaphezulu nongu-6 okanye ngaphantsi) netheyibhile yamaxabiso e-y afunyenwe ngokufaka amaxabiso ambalwa e-x ziboniswa ngokutsha. Cinga ngawo onke amanani angempela e-x ngaphakathi koluhlu.
z-m-19-03.thinking.0: Ukugcina okanye ukuphinda ujonge isigwebo ngokwenkcazelo entsha
z-m-19-03.thinking.1: Ukwahlula ngeemeko ngokuba incopho ingaphakathi okanye ingaphandle koluhlu
z-m-19-03.thinking.2: Ukwenza uluhlu olufanelekileyo kwiimeko wena nokuhlola ixabiso
z-m-19-03.prereq.0: Ukufunda incopho ne-axis yokulinganisela yomsebenzi wekhwadratiki y=a(x−p)²+q (inqanaba lebanga lesi-9)
z-m-19-03.prereq.1: Ukufaka ixabiso le-x kwintetho ukufumana ixabiso le-y
z-m-19-03.s.s1.prompt: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, gweba ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwisitatimenti sika-Doha 'inani eliphantsi kakhulu li-−3' ngokuxhomekeke kuluhlu lwe-x.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuba ixabiso elincinci le-y kwitheyibhile lenzeka kwi-x ephi na nokuba loo x iphakathi koluhlu olu.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.1: Faka i-x engekho kwitheyibhile (umzekelo, 2.5 okanye 3.5) kwintetho uze uvavanye ukuba iba ncinci kuneexabiso zakwitheyibhile.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Uluhlu: i-x ngamanani angempela onke. Intetho: y=(x−2)²−3. Itheyibhile yamaxabiso (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Liliphi inani eliphantsi kakhulu lalo msebenzi?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.after: (x−2)²≥0, ngoko y≥−3, kwaye xa x=2, y=−3. Kwitheyibhile nayo, ixabiso elincinci lingu-−3 kwi-x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ukhethe ixabiso elisekupheleni kwetheyibhile. Thelekisa ukuba ixabiso elincinci le-y kuyo yonke itheyibhile liphi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umile malunga ne-x=1 okanye i-x=3. Thelekisa nexabiso kwi-x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Nokuba i-x nayiphi na inani langempela, (x−2)² ayincipheli ngaphantsi kuka-0. Hlola ukuba ixabiso lehla ngokungapheliyo na.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Imeko entsha: uluhlu lwe-x lutshintshele kwi-0≤x≤5. Itheyibhile yamaxabiso (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uluhlu lube lumxinwa. Uza kugweba ntoni ngenani eliphantsi kakhulu?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.after: I-x=2 iphakathi koluhlu, ngoko i-−3 isenokuphuma, kwaye ngenxa yemilo yentetho, (x−2)²≥0, ayincipheli ngaphantsi kwe-−3 nakwi-x engekho kwitheyibhile. Nokuba kukho ulwazi olutsha, isigwebo sinokuhlala sifana. Ukuthi kwitheyibhile kuphela 'kunzima ukuqiniseka' kwakungumphezulu ofanelekileyo nawo.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ihlala i-−3. I-x=2 iphakathi koluhlu olu
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Iyatshintsha. Inani eliphantsi kakhulu yi-y=1 ekupheleni kwasekhohlo koluhlu, i-x=0
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ucinge ukuba xa uluhlu lutshintsha, isiphelo siba lelona nani liphantsi kakhulu. Hlola kwitheyibhile ukuba ixabiso kwi-x=2 liphakathi koluhlu na.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kunzima ukuqiniseka ngetheyibhile kuphela. Isenokuba incinci kune-−3 kwi-x engekho kwitheyibhile
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Iyatshintsha. Inani eliphantsi kakhulu yi-y=6 ekupheleni kwasekunene koluhlu, i-x=5
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukhethe ixabiso lasekupheleni kwasekunene. Thelekisa nexabiso elincinci kwitheyibhile.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Imeko entsha: uluhlu lwe-x lutshintshele kwi-3≤x≤6 (i-x=2 yencopho ayiphakathi koluhlu olu). Itheyibhile yamaxabiso (x → y): 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6, 6 → 13.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Liliphi inani eliphantsi kakhulu kuluhlu olu?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.after: I-x=2 ingaphandle koluhlu, ngoko i-−3 ayinakuphuma. Ngaphakathi koluhlu, y iya iba nkulu njengoko x iba nkulu, ngoko inani eliphantsi kakhulu i-−2 liphuma kwi-x=3 ekhohlo kakhulu.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Eli lixabiso le-x=2. Hlola ukuba loo x iphakathi koluhlu olu.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Eli lixabiso eliphakathi kwetheyibhile. Thelekisa kwakhona ukuba ixabiso elincinci le-y kwitheyibhile liphi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukhethe elona xabiso likhulu kwitheyibhile. Hlola kwakhona ukuba inani eliphantsi kakhulu yintoni.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.reflect: Isigwebo sokuqala, 'ixabiso le-y yencopho linani eliphantsi kakhulu,' sichanekile kuphela xa i-x yencopho iphakathi koluhlu. Njengakwinyathelo 2, isigwebo sinokuhlala sifana nokuba kukho ulwazi olutsha, kwaye njengakwinyathelo 3, kufuneka uphinde ujonge isigwebo xa imeko itshintsha. Isitshixo kukujonga ukuba yintoni etshintshile (ukuba incopho ingaphakathi okanye ingaphandle koluhlu) uze ugqibe ukuba ugcine okanye uphinde ujonge.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.prompt: Kwi-y=x²−4x+1, misela uluhlu lwe-x njenge-p≤x≤q (p, q ziinani ezipheleleyo, −4≤p<q≤8) ukuze i-x=2 yencopho ibe ngaphandle koluhlu. Bhala nenani eliphantsi kakhulu m kuloo luhlu. Yenza uluhlu olu-2 olwahlukileyo.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.0: Phawula kumgca wamanani ukuba p no-q kufuneka babe kweyiphi icala le-2 ukuze uluhlu lungabandakanyi i-x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana amaxabiso e-y kwii-x ezimbini zasekupheleni koluhlu olukhethileyo uze uhlole ukuba encinci ilingana no-m.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c1: p no-q kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele anee-−4≤p<q≤8.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c2: I-x=2 iphakathi kuka-p no-q. Tshintsha uluhlu ukuze lungabandakanyi i-2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c3: m ayichanekanga. Fumana amaxabiso e-y kwii-x ezimbini zasekupheleni koluhlu uze uthelekise.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.explain: Ukuba i-x=2 yencopho ingaphandle koluhlu, y itshintsha kwicala elinye kuphela ngaphakathi koluhlu. Ngoko inani eliphantsi kakhulu liphuma kwisiphelo esisondele kwi-2. umz., kwi-3≤x≤6, li-−2 kwi-x=3; kwi-−3≤x≤0, li-1 kwi-x=0; kwi-−4≤x≤1, li-−2 kwi-x=1. Akukho meko apho i-−3 iphuma khona.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.prompt: Kwenye imisebenzi, y=−(x−1)²+4, ufuna ukufumana inani elikhulu kakhulu xa uluhlu lwe-x lungu-−2≤x≤0. Yintoni efanelekileyo yokuqala ukuyihlola?
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.0: Phawula i-−2, i-0, ne-x=1 yencopho kumgca wamanani.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba indawo apho inani elikhulu kakhulu lenzeka khona yahluka njani kuxhomekeke kwi-x yencopho iphakathi koluhlu okanye hayi.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.a: Bhala ngoko nangoko i-4, ixabiso le-y yencopho (1, 4), njengenani elikhulu kakhulu
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.a: Awuhlolanga ukuba i-x yencopho iphakathi koluhlu. Le yingxaki efanayo nesizathu sokuba i-−3 ayinakuphuma kwinyathelo langaphambili.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.b: Fumana amaxabiso e-y kuzo zombini iziphelo zoluhlu, x=−2 no-x=0, uze ukhethe elikhulu
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.b: Kulo msebenzi noluhlu impendulo efanayo iyaphuma, kodwa yindlela enokuphosisa ixabiso lencopho xa incopho iphakathi koluhlu.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.c: Igrafu ijonge phezulu, ngoko qala ufumane inani eliphantsi kakhulu
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.c: Okubuzwayo linani elikhulu kakhulu, ngoko usenokuba ubhidanise ubudlelwane phakathi kwesalathiso sejika nenani elikhulu nelincinci.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.d: Qala ujonge ukuba i-x-coordinate yencopho, 1, iphakathi koluhlu −2≤x≤0 na
z-m-19-03.s.s3.explain: I-x=1 ayiphakathi kwe-−2≤x≤0, ngoko inani elikhulu kakhulu aliyi-4 yencopho. Ngaphakathi koluhlu, y iya iba nkulu njengoko x iba nkulu, ngoko inani elikhulu kakhulu yi-y=3 kwi-x=0, kwaye kwi-x=−2 li-−5. Ukuba incopho iphakathi koluhlu, ixabiso lencopho liyakhethwa; ukuba iphandle, amaxabiso eziphelo ayakhethwa.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.acc.0: Kulo msebenzi noluhlu, i-x=1 yencopho ingaphandle koluhlu, ngoko indlela yokuthelekisa zombini iziphelo nayo inika impendulo efanayo, 3. Noko ke, kwezinye iingxaki apho incopho iphakathi koluhlu, unokuphosisa ixabiso lencopho, ngoko umkhwa wokuqala ujonge indawo yencopho ukhuselekile ngakumbi.

z-m-19-04.title: Ingaba ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni kwii-arc zobude obufanayo ziyalingana?
z-m-19-04.topic: Ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni nobude be-arc: ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni kwii-arc zobude obufanayo
z-m-19-04.goal: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwinkcazo 'ukuba ubude be-arc buyalingana, ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni ziyalingana,' fumana ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni ezenziwa zii-arc zobude obufanayo kwizangqa ezinerediyasi ezahlukileyo, uze uchaze imeko apho ibango lisebenza khona.
z-m-19-04.material: Isangqa O sinerediyasi engu-6 cm, kwaye isangqa O' (O prime) sinerediyasi engu-12 cm. I-arc AB esangqeni O ne-arc CD esangqeni O' zombini zinobude obungu-4π cm, kwaye i-arc nganye incinci kunesiqingatha sesangqa. U-Doyun wathi, "Ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni kwii-arc zobude obufanayo ziyalingana," waza wacacisa njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi. (I-engile ebhalwe esangqeni ∠APB yi-engile apho inqaku P esangqeni, kwicala elingelilo le-arc AB, lijonge u-A no-B, kwaye ∠CQD injalo. ∠APB ifundwa 'engile APB'.)
z-m-19-04.thinking.1: Ukwenza imizekelo emininzi yamanani ukubona ulwakhiwo lomzekelo ochasayo
z-m-19-04.thinking.2: Ukuchaza imeko apho ibango lisebenza khona
z-m-19-04.prereq.0: Ubukhulu be-engile ebhalwe esangqeni kwi-arc bubungqamaxesha asisiqingatha sobukhulu be-engile ephakathi kwi-arc leyo (inqanaba lebanga lesi-9)
z-m-19-04.prereq.1: Ubude be-arc 2πr×(x/360) kwi-engile ephakathi x° kwisangqa serediyasi r (inqanaba lebanga lesi-7)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwinkcazo ka-Doyun ongenakuthenjwa. (Kungcono ukhethe umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo, kodwa ungakhetha nomgca apho isigqibo esingachanekanga sibhalwe ngenxa yoko.)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuba umgca ngamnye ulandela ngqo kumgca wangaphambili, uze uqwalasele ukuba ii-rediyasi zezangqa ezimbini ziyafana okanye ziyahluka.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba i-engile ephakathi ye-arc yobude obungu-4π ingaphi iidigri kwisangqa ngasinye uze uthelekise.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.0: Isangqa O sinerediyasi engu-6, isangqa O' sinerediyasi engu-12, kwaye ii-arc AB no-CD zombini zinobude obungu-4π.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.1: Ubude be-arc buyalingana, ngoko ubukhulu bee-engile ezimbini ezi-ephakathi ze-arc nabo buyalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.2: I-engile ebhalwe esangqeni sisiqingatha se-engile ephakathi, ngoko ∠APB ne-∠CQD nazo ziyalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni kwii-arc zobude obufanayo ziyalingana rhoqo.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo ngumgca 2. Ubude be-arc bumiselwa yirediyasi ne-engile ephakathi kunye, ngoko kwizangqa ezimbini ezinerediyasi ezahlukileyo, nokuba ubude buyalingana, ii-engile ezi-ephakathi ziyahluka. Kwisangqa O, 4π=2π×6×(x/360) inika i-engile ephakathi ye-120°, kwaye kwisangqa O', 4π=2π×12×(x/360) inika i-engile ephakathi ye-60°. Ngoko ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni ziyahluka, 60° kunye ne-30°. 'I-engile ebhalwe esangqeni sisiqingatha se-engile ephakathi' kumgca 3 sisitatimenti esichanekileyo, kodwa ithwala isiphumo somgca 2, ngoko isigqibo asichanekanga, kwaye umgca 4 unjalo. Umgca 1 yimeko enikiweyo, ngoko awunangxaki.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: Kwisangqa serediyasi r cm kukho i-arc yobude obungu-4π cm (isiqingatha sesangqa okanye incinci). Fumana i-engile ebhalwe esangqeni θ (iidigri) kule arc, uze wenze izangqa ezi-3 ezinerediyasi ezahlukileyo. (r isuka kwi-4 ukuya kwi-30, kwaye ubhale r no-θ njengamaxabiso achanekileyo.)
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ufumane i-engile ephakathi ye-arc yobude obungu-4π kwisangqa se-r=6, uze ufumane i-engile ebhalwe esangqeni kuyo.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala r no-θ kwitheyibhile uze ukhangele ukuba yeyiphi imveliso okanye isixa samaxabiso amabini esingatshintshiyo.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c1: r kufuneka isuke kwi-4 ukuya kwi-30.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Yi-engile ebhalwe esangqeni ehambelana nobude be-arc obungu-4π.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c2: I-engile ephakathi yi-2θ. Hlola ukuba ubude be-arc 2πr×(2θ/360) bungu-4π na. Khetha r enika ixabiso elichanekileyo, hayi ixabiso eliqikelelweyo.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.explain: I-engile ephakathi yi-2θ, ngoko ubude be-arc bungu-2πr×(2θ/360)=πrθ/90. Ukuba oku kungu-4π, ngoko rθ=360. Ukuba r=6, θ=60; ukuba r=12, θ=30; ukuba r=9, θ=40; ukuba r=4, θ=90. Nokuba ubude be-arc bufana, nokuba irediyasi inkulu kangakanani, i-engile ebhalwe esangqeni incinci.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.prompt: Cacisela u-Doyun. Yimeko eyongezelelweyo ethini efunekayo ukuthi ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni kwii-arc ezimbini zobude obufanayo ziyalingana? Kwaye kutheni zilingana phantsi kwaloo meko?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.0: Jonga ukuba θ yintoni xa r ifana kwitheyibhile esi-s2.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba kuyiphi phakathi kobude be-arc, irediyasi, ne-engile ephakathi kufuneka ifane ukuze ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni zilingane.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uhlole ukuba imeko oyibhalileyo iyayigatya yonke imizekelo oyenzileyo kwi-s2 (izangqa ezinerediyasi ezahlukileyo)?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ucacise 'kutheni zilingana' ngokunxulumana ne-engile ephakathi?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.0: Ii-arc ezimbini kufuneka zibe sesangqeni esinye (okanye izangqa ezinerediyasi efanayo). Ukuba irediyasi ifana, xa ubude be-arc bulingana ii-engile ezi-ephakathi ziyalingana, kwaye i-engile ebhalwe esangqeni sisiqingatha se-engile ephakathi, ngoko ziyalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.1: Imeko yokuba ii-rediyasi ziyafana iyafuneka. Ukuba ziyahluka, njenge-6 ne-12, ii-engile ezi-ephakathi ziyahluka, 120° kunye ne-60°, ngoko ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni ziyi-60° kunye ne-30°. Ngerediyasi efanayo, i-engile ephakathi ilingana ngokulinganelana nobude be-arc, ngoko ii-engile ezibhalwe esangqeni nazo ziyalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ukuthi 'ii-engile ezi-ephakathi ziyalingana' endaweni 'yobude be-arc' kuyafana kwinto.
